note: Unchanged on re-read: TestISISTLVIPv4RoundTrip lost only its RFC1195-5.2-4 comment tag. Forbidden behaviour: rejecting a TLV that carries unknown sub-TLVs, or not skipping them so the next entry misparses. TestISISTLV22RoundTrip (tlv_core_test.go) keeps entry0's three uninterpreted sub-TLVs opaque and then asserts entry1's metric equals types.MaxMetric, which goes red on a wrong skip; TestISISTLVIPv4RoundTrip (with-subtlv) goes red if a type-1 sub-TLV is rejected. Negative TestISISTLV22Truncated proves an overrunning length is not skipped as absent.
